description: This C# source file defines the CatalogContextSeed class which provides functionality to seed initial data into the Catalog database context for the eShopWeb application. It includes methods to seed catalog brands, types, and items, in addition to handling database migrations and retrying on failures.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to seed initial catalog data into the database.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds catalog data (brands, types, items) into the database, with retry logic in case of failures.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of catalog brands for seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of catalog types for seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of catalog items for seeding.
